brief: 5 free design tools every solo founder uses to ship pixel-perfect UI.

slots.desc1: Collaborative interface design with real-time multiplayer editing.
slots.desc2: Open-source prototyping platform built for cross-functional product teams.
slots.desc3: Generate beautiful color palettes in seconds with one click.
slots.desc4: High-resolution stock photos free for commercial projects worldwide.
slots.desc5: Professional vector graphics editor for logos and illustrations.

slots.toolTagline: The collaborative interface design platform that runs in your browser.
slots.bigStatement: Design pixel-perfect mockups and prototypes without downloading a single file.
slots.use1Body: Build reusable components and shared libraries that keep your product consistent.
slots.use2Body: Wireframe user flows and test interactions before writing any production code.
slots.use3Body: Copy CSS values, export assets, and inspect specs directly from the canvas.

slots.toolTagline: The first open-source design and prototyping platform for product teams.
slots.bigStatement: Own your design stack with self-hosted files and zero vendor lock-in.
slots.use1Body: Host on your own servers or use the cloud with full code transparency.
slots.use2Body: Edit vector paths directly with SVG standards that scale to any screen size.
slots.use3Body: Collaborate in real time with developers who inspect code-ready designs.

slots.toolTagline: Generate stunning color palettes instantly for any brand or interface.
slots.bigStatement: Lock in your brand identity with accessible contrast ratios and exportable codes.
slots.use1Body: Press spacebar to cycle through harmonious color combinations in seconds.
slots.use2Body: Check WCAG contrast scores to ensure readable text on every background.
slots.use3Body: Download palettes as CSS, SVG, or PNG for quick handoff to your stack.

slots.toolTagline: Free high-resolution photography for commercial and personal projects alike.
slots.bigStatement: Ship polished marketing pages with premium imagery that costs exactly zero dollars.
slots.use1Body: Grab striking hero backgrounds that load fast and look professional.
slots.use2Body: Find lifestyle shots to contextually frame your SaaS or mobile app.
slots.use3Body: Download square and portrait crops perfect for Twitter and LinkedIn posts.

slots.toolTagline: Professional vector graphics editor for logos, icons, and print-ready art.
slots.bigStatement: Craft scalable logos and icon sets that stay crisp at any resolution.
slots.use1Body: Draw bezier curves and combine paths to build memorable brand marks.
slots.use2Body: Export entire icon systems in multiple sizes with one batch action.
slots.use3Body: Export PDFs and EPS files for swag, packaging, and investor decks.

slots.toolTagline: The open-source image editor for advanced retouching and asset prep.
slots.bigStatement: Replace pricey suites with layer-based power and full plugin extensibility.
slots.use1Body: Heal blemishes, adjust levels, and crop assets for pixel-perfect delivery.
slots.use2Body: Slice multiple assets and export optimized PNGs, WebPs, and JPEGs.
slots.use3Body: Add filters, automate tasks, and extend functionality with community scripts.

slots.body: This zero-cost toolkit replaces expensive subscriptions and keeps your startup lean from day one.
